question: Is sens-e (2.398 GB) a floor, or just the first allocation that came out clean?
answer: Not a floor. Bounded coordinate descent reached 2.225 GB still clean, a 7.2% cut.
method: One change per step from the current NR, only changes that SHRINK the artifact, accept the smallest that gates clean, repeat. Not a combinatorial sweep -- LAW012 and the one-off both warn that independently-safe reductions do not compose. LAW025 forbids reusing the loo sensitivity map here: it was measured against a uniform 4-bit base, not against sens-e's, so every neighbour was re-measured.
screen: tools/future/tts_gate.stuck_run for the fixed point, plus energy and duration. No ASR in the loop -- the fixed-point detector is what makes an ASR-free screen possible, so an arm costs a render and nothing else. ASR is spent only on the finalist.

path.result: exhausted: all 5 neighbours rendered and were dirty

final.validation: n=32 on a different seed QUEUED; not sealed until it lands

why_ebpw_exceeds_4: A '4-bit' checkpoint is not 4 bits per weight. Complete EBPW bills every byte the loader reads -- scales and biases included -- which is 0.195 bits/weight of overhead here. Group 128 cut it from 4.497 by halving the number of scale groups.
corrected: The EBPW printed during the run (~29) was wrong: it counted packed uint32 ELEMENTS as logical params instead of recovering 32/bits per element. Ranking was on GB and is unaffected; the EBPW column in the run log should be ignored in favour of these recomputed values.
what_the_descent_refutes: The single-organ map measured against a uniform 4-bit base said only down_proj and embed_tokens tolerate 2 bits. It did NOT predict that o_proj tolerates 3 bits on top of that base, nor that group 128 is free there while it jams 6/8 on a 3-bit base. Both were found only by re-measuring around the current NR, which is exactly what LAW025 requires.

exhaustion_is_complete.group_size: mx.quantize refuses group_size 256 and 512 -- 'The requested group size is not supported'. 128 is the maximum, so the descent's cap at 128 did not cut the search short; the group-size lever is genuinely exhausted at the accepted value.
exhaustion_is_complete.bit_width: Every organ group was offered every mlx bit width below its current one. At step 3 all five survivors rendered dirty and none was marginal (gateup3 7/8, qkv3 5/8, o2 8/8, gateup2 8/8, qkv2 7/8), so there is no near-miss to revisit.
exhaustion_is_complete.multi_organ: S006 53 licenses a two-change step only after single-step evidence exists. It now does, and it argues against: the step-3 failures are not marginal, so combining two of them has no path to clean. Not attempted, and that is the reason.
exhaustion_is_complete.verdict: 2.225 GB / complete EBPW 4.195 is the floor for this method and this bit-and-group lever set. Going lower needs a different representation gene, not a further search of this one.
